name: Giantbane

automation.text:
You have Advantage on attack rolls against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force damage against such creatures.

Add `-d 2d6[force] adv` to attacks against Large or larger creatures.

description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against Large or larger creatures, and your attacks deal an extra 2d6 Force damage against such creatures.
